subject.title: Compaction should use auth-profile rotation / failover within the same provider

question: Should OpenClaw add same-provider auth-profile failover to compaction for auto-selected profiles, and what stable-snapshot/apply-once boundary must that retry path enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but compaction retries affect both auth-provider semantics and session-state correctness, and the direct implementation PR closed unmerged without settling the product contract.

options.title: Approve bounded compaction failover
options.body: Sponsor or request a new focused PR that rotates only auto/inherited same-provider profiles and preserves user-locked profiles plus apply-once transcript semantics.

options.title: Define a narrower contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which retry reasons, profile-source states, and transcript-snapshot checks are acceptable before implementation.

options.title: Decline compaction profile rotation
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers intentionally want compaction to stay stricter than normal agent turns and document that distinction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded compaction failover
recommendation.body: Sponsor or request a new focused PR that rotates only auto/inherited same-provider profiles and preserves user-locked profiles plus apply-once transcript semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across compaction, provider/auth runtime, and model-failover policy surfaces.
